classification.difficultyReason: Identify two packets as 2x and three loose biscuits as a constant, applying the taught container model in a new context.

content.prompt: There are $x$ biscuits in each packet. Write an expression for the total number of biscuits.

spec.description: Two biscuit packets on the left, each labelled BISCUITS with packaging artwork, and three overlapping loose biscuits on the right.
spec.mathematics: Two packets each contain x biscuits; three biscuits are loose. Packaging artwork is not an additional count.
spec.answerVisibility: The illustration is permanently visible; the supplied expression belongs only in answers.

answer.worked: Two packets contain $2x$ biscuits. Including the three loose biscuits gives $2x+3$ biscuits.
